item.title: Photos: Nicole Scherzinger, Marisha Wallace, and Todrick Hall Visit CATS: THE JELLICLE BALL!
item.description: Performances are now underway for the Broadway production of CATS: The Jellicle Ball at the Broadhurst Theatre. The show recently was paid a visit by stars Nicole Scherzinger, Marisha Wallace, and Todrick Hall. Check out photos here!

item.title: RAGTIME Extends For a Second Time on Broadway
item.description: Lincoln Center Theater’s revival of Ragtime, directed by Kewsong Lee Artistic Director Lear deBessonet, announced that its limited engagement has been extended by popular demand for a second time.

item.title: Phillip James Brannon, Cheyenne Jackson, and Bianca Leigh Will Return to OH, MARY!
item.description: Next month, two-time Obie Award winner Phillip James Brannon, Grammy and Emmy Award nominee Cheyenne Jackson, and original Off-Broadway and Broadway cast member Bianca Leigh will return to the Lyceum Theatre to reprise their roles in Oh, Mary!

item.title: Barry Manilow to Release New Album of Original Material
item.description: Grammy, Tony, and Emmy Award-winning artist Barry Manilow has announced his new studio album, What A Time, due out June 5, marking his first album of new material in nearly 15 years.

item.description: Jamie Lloyd’s reimagined revival of Evita is eyeing a potential Broadway transfer in 2027. Rachel Zegler has commented on the possibility of the famous outdoor balcony scene being recreated for Broadway.

item.title: Video: Sara Bareilles Shares Memories of Gavin Creel on Anderson Cooper
item.description: Tony-nominated actor and composer Sara Bareilles joined journalist Anderson Cooper on his All There Is podcast this week. During her interview, Sara reflected on the life and loss of her best friend, Tony Award-winner Gavin Creel. Watch a video clip from her episode below.

item.title: Review Roundup: GIANT Opens On Broadway Starring John Lithgow As Roald Dahl
item.description: Reviews are in for GIANT, the Olivier Award-winning play by Mark Rosenblatt, now on Broadway starring John Lithgow as Roald Dahl. Directed by Nicholas Hytner, the production is playing a limited 16-week engagement following its award-winning West End run, where it received three Olivier Awards.

item.title: Video: Diego Andres Rodriguez And Mike Wartella Perform ‘Make It Alone’ From THE WANDERER
item.description: A new video features Diego Andres Rodriguez and Mike Wartella performing “Make It Alone” from The Wanderer. The Broadway-bound musical is based on the life and music of Dion DiMucci.

item.title: Photos: John Lithgow and the Cast of GIANT Take Opening Night Bows
item.description: Performances are now underway for GIANT, starring John Lithgow as Roald Dahl. The production officially opened on March 23. Check out photos of the cast taking their opening night bows here!

item.title: TRAINSPOTTING Musical Will Make World Premiere in London in July
item.description: Thirty years after the film was released, the World Premiere of Trainspotting The Musical will make its West End premiere this summer, written by Irvine Welsh and directed and developed by Caroline Jay Ranger.

item.title: WNO Artistic Director Francesca Zambello Inducted Into OPERA America
item.description: Washington National Opera Artistic Director Francesca Zambello was inducted into the OPERA America Opera Hall of Fame at the OPERA America Salutes Awards Dinner on Friday, March 20, 2026, at The Plaza Hotel.
